summary: International General Insurance Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to announce the publication of its Financial Condition Report (FCR) for the year ended December 31, 2025, on its website. The FCR was also filed with the Bermuda Monetary Authority. It covers business performance, governance, risk management, and capital management. This is a routine regulatory disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No event qualifies as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
